title: docs(skills): teach os environments use-runtime and os mcp connect
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xKoxHJ3zQQdUAbBUgta4iFN)_

Fixes #31143

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a MANDATORY model tier for `skills/**` (clause ① of the model-tiering ruling); it is waived by the standing order of the maintainer in this project (2026-11-03), and this card ran on the project's default model. The dispatching seat runs the contract review.

**Cross-seat note:** `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` and `content/docs/deployment/publish-and-preview.mdx` are folded into this `domain:skills` card by the triage (6708594558), so the skill and the docs say the same thing. `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` § "Claude Code (one command)" (the page that gives the `claude mcp add` line) was confirmed by the seat by name before it was edited.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：平台技能 `operations.md` 新增 `os environments use-runtime` 与 `os mcp connect` 两行，`os deploy` 行加自托管目标的流程（构建 → 试运行计划 → 内联安装 → `hotLoaded` 即上线，`--confirm-access-upgrade`），`os package install` 行写明不带 `-u` 时回落到记住的运行时；`cli.mdx` 新增「Deploy to a self-hosted runtime」「To a self-hosted runtime」「MCP / `os mcp connect`」三节并更新 install 的 `-u`/`-t` 默认值；`publish-and-preview.mdx` 加一段；`connect-mcp.mdx` 在手敲 `claude mcp add` 之前先介绍 `os mcp connect`；评测加两例。
- 为什么改：#30888（PR #31137）与 #30889（PR #31149）已合并，文档和技能没教，开发者与 AI 仍手敲地址、令牌和 `claude mcp add`（#31143）。
- 风险与回滚：只改文档、技能文字与 eval；`operations.md` 先删 8 处同文件重述/错述（−594 字节），余额 +53 token 按常设裁决 6513306068 提高该行上限 3287 → 3340；发 `@objectstack/skills` patch；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` 的 § Environments & deploy 表，以及下方「删减与去处」表（含席位裁定删除的 `os login` / `os register` 两行错述）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期退出 0，`operations.md 3340 / 3340`。
- 需要你做的：`skills/**` 属 Tier H（人合），需要 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 的一次 approval，之后席位落地。

## What changes

### 1. The platform skill (`skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md`)

```diff
-| `os login` / `logout` / `whoami` | Auth against the ObjectStack cloud control plane |
-| `os register` | Register the local stack as a deployable target |
+| `os environments use-runtime <url> --token <key>` | Deploy to a self-hosted runtime instead: the key (one it issued) is tried first (`--no-verify` skips), then kept in `~/.objectstack/cloud.json` (0600) across cloud login/logout. `--forget` or `os environments switch` targets the cloud again |
-… `--no-wait`; `--wait-timeout <seconds>` (600) |
+… `--no-wait`; `--wait-timeout <seconds>` (600). A `use-runtime` target, no `--env`: build, dry-run plan, install, live on `hotLoaded`; `--confirm-access-upgrade <token>` |
-| `os package install <manifest-id │ ./dist/objectstack.json> [--version │ -u/--url http://localhost:3000]` | … not the cloud login |
+| `os package install <manifest-id │ ./dist/objectstack.json> [--version │ -u/--url]` | … not the cloud login. No `-u`: the `use-runtime` runtime and, with no `-t`/`--email`, its key; else `http://localhost:3000` |
+| `os mcp connect` | Register the cloud environment's MCP server (picked as `os deploy` picks it) with Claude Code (`claude mcp add`); `--url <base>` for a self-hosted or local server (named `objectstack`); `--name`; `--print` runs nothing (other clients). Stores no token: the client runs the server's own OAuth |
```

The skill rows stay short and the full sequence lives in the CLI reference (the order's preference).

### 2. The docs

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: a `use-runtime` row in § Cloud Environments; new § "Deploy to a self-hosted runtime" (examples, the key and its probe, `--no-verify`, storage, which of `use-runtime` / `switch` wins, `--forget`, a flag table); § `os deploy` names the self-hosted target in its lead, gains a `--confirm-access-upgrade` row and a "To a self-hosted runtime" subsection (the four steps and the `d` key); new § MCP / `os mcp connect` (examples, environment resolution, `--url`, names, `--client`, `--print`, failure exits, no token, revoke, a flag table); § `os package install`'s `-u` and `-t` rows now give the remembered runtime as the default.
- `content/docs/deployment/publish-and-preview.mdx` § 3 "Install a version": one paragraph on remembering a runtime with `use-runtime` so `os deploy` and the `d` key deploy there, the `os package install` fallback, and how to target the cloud again.
- `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` § "Claude Code (one command)": one paragraph plus a fence before the hand-typed lines, which stay.

## Code site per taught sentence (`main` `66bf5b4a`)

| Taught | Code site |
|:--|:--|
| `os environments use-runtime <url> --token <key>`; `-t` reads `OS_RUNTIME_TOKEN` | `packages/cli/src/commands/environments/use-runtime.ts` `args.url` (L40–L42), `flags.token` (L45–L49) |
| The key is tried first on `GET /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`; 401/403, 404, unreachable refused, nothing recorded | `use-runtime.ts` L93–L100, `probeRuntime` (L142–L178) |
| `--no-verify` records anyway (a container not up yet) | `use-runtime.ts` `verify` flag (L50–L54, `allowNo`), header L21–L25 |
| URL is an http(s) base URL, no query or fragment | `normalizeRuntimeUrl` (L118–L135) |
| `--forget` drops the record; cloud is the target again; not with a url | `use-runtime.ts` L65–L77; `forgetRuntimeTarget` (`packages/cli/src/utils/runtime-target.ts` L65–L69) |
| Stored in `~/.objectstack/cloud.json`, 0600, its own record; key sent only to its url | `packages/cli/src/utils/cloud-config.ts` header L31–L44, `getCloudCredentialsPath` L106, `writeFile(..., { mode: 0o600 })` L132; `runtime-target.ts` header L23–L27 |
| Cloud logout keeps it; cloud login keeps it | `cloud-config.ts` `deleteCloudConfig` L193–L195, `writeCloudConfig` L187–L190 (header L40–L43) |
| `os environments switch <id>` (when recorded in cloud.json) makes the cloud the target again, keeping the runtime | `packages/cli/src/commands/environments/switch.ts` L78–L79; `activateCloudDeployTarget` (`runtime-target.ts` L76–L81) |
| `os deploy` with a runtime target and no `--env` deploys there; `--env` names a cloud environment | `packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts` L152–L156 |
| Self-hosted sequence: build → dry run (plan printed; a runtime that predates it installs anyway, said, exit 1) → install (a register failure is refused here) → `hotLoaded` ⇒ 0 | `deploy.ts` `deployToRuntime` L288–L335, header L49–L71; `install.ts` L511–L522 (dry run ignored ⇒ INSTALLED, exit 1) and L617–L622 (an inline manifest whose register throws is refused `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED`) |
| `--confirm-access-upgrade <token>` passed through; refused when the target is the cloud | `deploy.ts` flag L138–L142, L157–L164, L320 |
| The `d` key runs the same `os deploy`, no cloud login asked | `packages/cli/src/utils/dev-deploy-key.ts` header L26–L31, `deployKeyHint` L74–L75, L118 |
| `os package install` with no `-u`: the remembered runtime (its key when no `-t` / `--email` and the url is its own), else `http://localhost:3000` | `runtime-target.ts` `runtimeInstallTarget` L92–L108, `DEFAULT_RUNTIME_INSTALL_URL` L38; `packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts` flags L218–L234, L328–L337 |
| `os mcp connect` resolves the cloud environment as `os deploy`: `--env`, active, only; none/several refused naming `--env`; a remembered runtime is not consulted | `packages/cli/src/commands/mcp/connect.ts` header L8–L15, `resolveInstallTarget` call L202–L212 (no runtime-target read in the file) |
| MCP URL = environment origin + `/api/v1/mcp`; registered under its slug / display name / id, lower-cased, other runs → `-` | `connect.ts` `MCP_ENDPOINT_PATH` L54, `environmentServerName` L78–L84, L234–L235 |
| `--url` skips the cloud, adds `/api/v1/mcp`, refuses a URL ending in it, name `objectstack` | `connect.ts` `mcpUrlFromBase` L91–L113, L182–L191; `OBJECTSTACK_MCP_SERVER_NAME = 'objectstack'` (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` L51) |
| `--name` overrides (letters, digits, `-`, `_`) | `connect.ts` flag L143–L145, `SERVER_NAME` L60, L173–L177 |
| `--client claude-code` is the only value and the default; runs `claude mcp add --transport http NAME URL` | `connect.ts` `MCP_CLIENTS` L57, flag L146–L150, `claudeMcpAddArgs` L63–L65 |
| `--print` prints the endpoint and the line, runs nothing; other clients add the endpoint themselves | `connect.ts` flag L151–L154, header L35–L41, L243–L248 |

| No token stored; `--token` only finds the environment; sign-in via `/mcp`; revoke in Account → Connect an AI Assistant | `connect.ts` header L24–L33, `token` flag L161–L165, L273–L281 |

## Token readings and every deletion's home

`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` on fresh `main` `66bf5b4a`: `operations.md` **3285 / 3287** (headroom 2). With the teaching added: 3489 (+202 over). After the deletions below and the review's S1 correction: **3340**, 13140 → 13360 bytes (+220 net: −594 cut, +814 added). The remainder, **+53** measured, raises only that file's row 3287 → 3340, pinned at the measurement, under the standing maintainer ruling 2026-10-27, verbatim and untranslated: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068 on #27847). No other row changes. (The seat's ruling expected about +47; the extra 6 tokens are an accuracy fix found after it: the MCP row first said "the `os deploy` environment", but with a self-hosted target `os deploy` goes to the runtime while `os mcp connect` still resolves a cloud environment, so the row now says "the cloud environment (picked as `os deploy` picks it)".)

Every deletion, with every fact it held and where each survives (seat ruling: cuts 1–7 accepted):

| # | Cut (bytes) | Facts it held | Surviving home |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `os dev` row: " — idempotent, never overwrites an existing account" (53) | seeding never touches an existing account | the same row, whose "on an **empty** DB only" now reads "with **no login** yet" (review S1: the seed is gated on the absence of a login, not an empty user table, `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts` L777–L781; −2 bytes) |
| 2 | Verify item 2: "A bare `field` (missing `record.`) fails here." (47) | `os validate` refuses a bare field ref | the section intro (a bare field ref in a predicate faults; "Both are caught at author time by one command") and item 2's `record.<field>` existence check |
| 3 | "(`os lint` is a *separate* style/convention pass and does not replace `os validate`.)" (86) | lint is a style/convention pass; it is not the gate | Daily-loop `os lint` row ("Style/convention lint on metadata files") and the rule of thumb ("never report … done until `os validate` passes") |
| 4 | Production port row: " — a shifted port breaks reverse-proxy upstreams, better-auth callback URLs, and CORS trusted-origins as opaque 403/502s" (122) | what a shifted port breaks | Production guidance "Keep these in sync when you change the port (mismatch ⇒ better-auth `Invalid origin` 403 / CORS failures)" list: reverse-proxy upstream, `OS_AUTH_URL` / `baseURL` + `callbackURL`, `OS_TRUSTED_ORIGINS`. The word "502" is the one fact not restated. |
| 5 | Production guidance: " Don't rely on the `3000` default; it collides easily on shared hosts." (72) | don't rely on the default | "Pin the port explicitly — `PORT=8080 os start`" and the resolution chain showing `3000` as the default |
| 6 | Testing: " — with the in-memory driver a full bootstrap is cheap" (58) | a fresh kernel per test is cheap | the section intro: "tests run in milliseconds" |
| 7a | Row `os login` / `logout` / `whoami` · "Auth against the ObjectStack cloud control plane" (88) | **misstated**: `os login` authenticates against the runtime server and stores `credentials.json` (`login.ts` L240–L253); cloud auth is `os cloud login` | `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` § Authentication; the `os cloud login` row stays in the skill |
| 7b | Row `os register` · "Register the local stack as a deployable target" (68) | **misstated**: `os register` creates an account and stores credentials (`register.ts` L64) | `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` § Authentication |

Cut 6 joins its two lines into one (the deletion spans the line break); no other line is rewrapped. No test or script pins any cut text (grepped `packages/`, `scripts/`, `.claude/`, `skills/`, `content/`; only `packages/skills/dist` and CHANGELOGs carry copies).

## Eval cases (`skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json`)

- **21** · "We run ObjectStack's Docker image on our own server at https://objectos.example.com. How do I deploy my app there from the project without typing its URL and key every time?" → `use-runtime <url> --token <key>`, probe and `--no-verify`, `cloud.json` (0600) across login/logout, then `os deploy` / `d`: build, dry-run plan, inline install, live on `hotLoaded`, `--confirm-access-upgrade`; `os package install` fallback; `--forget` / `switch` back. `must_contain`: `os environments use-runtime`, `--token`; `must_not_contain`: `os deploy --url` (no such flag).
- **22** · "Connect Claude Code to our ObjectOS Cloud environment's MCP server, and to my local `os dev` server too." → `os mcp connect` (runs `claude mcp add --transport http <name> <url>`, environment as `os deploy` picks it, named after it), `--url http://localhost:3000` registered as `objectstack`, `--name`, `--print` for other clients, no token, `/mcp` sign-in. `must_contain`: `os mcp connect`, `--url`; `must_not_contain`: `--client cursor` (the only client is `claude-code`).

Swept the skill's evals for the old claims: no case encodes the cut text, `os login` / `os register`, or the `localhost:3000` install default; case 5's `os lint` and case 17's cloud `os deploy` stay true.

## Other sites found (not edited)

- `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` L99 and `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx` L477–L502 still give only the hand-typed `claude mcp add` line; `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx` is release history.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/environments/create.ts` (`--activate`) does not call `activateCloudDeployTarget`, so only `os environments switch` returns the deploy target to the cloud; the docs teach only `switch`. Whether `create --activate` should too is a CLI question, not a teaching one.

## Gates

Head `4e0b6486` (two commits on merge base `66bf5b4a`; the second is the review delta: S1, N3, N4, N7 and the N6 re-flow of the one ragged `os mcp connect` paragraph). `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives the same **87** commands as at `e15e06e1`; **all 87 exited 0**, 0 NOT MEASURED among them. Each ran with `timeout 900` under `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`, after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a full `pnpm build` (exit 0). The list with each exit code: `gates-4e0b6486.txt` in the card folder (round 1: `gates-e15e06e1.txt`, 87/87 exit 0). It includes `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-refs`, `pnpm check:skill-compatibility`, `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (and `--self-test`), `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:doc-anchors`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:docs`, `pnpm check:cli-command-ids`, `pnpm check:cli-examples-parity` and `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`.

The CI-only steps dispatch-gates names as NOT MEASURED (Build Docs, Build Core, the type-check lanes, dogfood and shard attestation) run in CI. `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0 before the push.
